title: Quickstart visuals for Rollouts, Version Pinning, and Fallback Policies
creator: Maya Alvarez
description: Design and produce a set of onboarding/quickstart UI assets and product screenshots that illustrate Rollouts (canary, A/B), version pinning, and fallback policy behaviors. Deliverables include annotated screenshots for docs, high-fidelity mockups for the console 'Create rollout' flow, a compact visuals pack for the quickstart guide, and a small library of export-ready PNG/SVG assets for engineering to embed in the docs site.
